europe_now.title: France blames Iran for cyberattacks on supermarkets
europe_now.summary: French authorities have accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of orchestrating recent cyberattacks targeting supermarket refrigerators. Foreign Minister Barrot confirmed the attribution amid ongoing security concerns.

sources.headline: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking

europe_now.title: Thirteen migrants die in shipwreck off Crete
europe_now.summary: Thirteen migrants have lost their lives after a boat sank off the coast of the Greek island of Crete. Rescue operations and investigations into the maritime incident are currently underway.

sources.headline: Thirteen migrants die after boat sinks off Crete

top_stories.title: French Social Unrest and Policy Responses
top_stories.summary: The French prime minister has accelerated a planned minimum wage hike in an effort to calm ongoing nationwide protests. However, labor unions have dismissed the adjustment as insufficient to address their grievances.

sources.headline: French PM brings forward 1.6% increase in minimum wage in bid to calm protests
'Crumbs': French PM's 1.6% minimum wage increase fails to placate unions

top_stories.title: Nvidia Leadership Under Scrutiny Over Espionage Allegations
top_stories.summary: Nvidia shares experienced a significant decline following the announcement of an investigation involving its CEO and suspected corporate espionage linked to China. Beijing has formally denied the spying allegations surrounding the controversy.
